author: NorthEast News Desk
body: Providence volleyball completed the Friar Classic with a straight-set victory over Holy Cross Saturday evening at Alumni Hall. The Friars won 25-19, 25-20 and 25-21 to improve to 8-1, finishing a two-match day in which they also swept Stonehill.

Tori Otter led Providence with nine kills and Sophia Adkins added eight. Miller McDonald recorded 17 assists and three service aces, while Gwen Koss also served three aces. Ava Dyer anchored the defense with 17 digs. Shea Dupuis and Aubrey Easterwood each took part in five blocks as the Friars held an 8-6 advantage at the net.

Providence finished with 36 kills, eight aces and 49 digs while limiting Holy Cross to a .077 hitting percentage. The Friars improved their own attack in every set, reaching .324 in the third when they produced 16 kills. The result completed a 3-0 tournament weekend for Providence, which next visits Harvard on September 18.
dek: The Friars won 25-19, 25-20 and 25-21, improving to 8-1 after a second straight Saturday sweep.
headline: Providence closes Friar Classic with sweep of Holy Cross
